item.text:
Audited all 47 verse and refrain lines in [ya-abbas.md](src/data/lyrics/ya-abbas.md) against the Urdu. Corrected Roman wording, nasalization, vowel spelling, and proper-name casing. The Urdu and metadata remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

Retained `saqqe` as the apparent reading of the irregular Urdu spelling `سققے`. That reading remains open for editorial review.
